title: How to Obtain UDID Card / Disability Certificate
issuingAuthority: District Medical Board / Chief Medical Officer (CMO) / Swavlamban Portal
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card and proof of address
Passport size color photographs showing disability
Clinical diagnosis / medical reports from authorized government hospital specialist
Previous disability certificate if applying for renewal or UDID conversion

steps.title: Register on Swavlamban Portal
steps.description: Create an account on swavlambancard.gov.in and fill personal details, disability category, and medical records.

steps.title: Medical Board Assessment
steps.description: Attend the designated District Hospital Medical Board on appointment date for physical assessment and percentage determination.

steps.title: UDID Generation
steps.description: Medical authority approves and issues digital Unique Disability ID (UDID) certificate indicating percentage of disability (minimum 40% required for scholarship eligibility).

validityPeriod: Permanent for irreversible conditions; 5 years temporary for progressive conditions.

sourceRef.portal: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Portal, DEPwD, Govt. of India
